name: pinebridge-bridge
description: Pinebridge: TradingView alerts to MetaTrader 5. Send TradingView alerts straight to MetaTrader 5 on your own Unraid server. No paid signal-relay service, no VPS. This container receives the TradingView webhook alerts and passes them over ZeroMQ to the Expert Advisor in pinebridge-mt5. Needs pinebridge-mt5 running alongside it; the webhook secret is generated for you. Places real trades automatically: read the risk notice (https://github.com/jakeshake/pinebridge/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md) and test on a demo account first.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Keeps the generated webhook secret and the dashboard database (pinebridge.db) across restarts and updates

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the webhook. Point your Cloudflare tunnel at http://[your Unraid IP]:[this port].

ports.name: Dashboard Port
ports.description: Pinebridge Dashboard (opens from WebUI). Shows account data: keep it on your LAN and never add it to your Cloudflare tunnel.

ports.name: EA Report Port
ports.description: The EA sends execution reports here (its ReportAddress input, default tcp://172.17.0.1:5556). LAN only.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional: password for the dashboard (any username). Recommended if others use your LAN.

variables.name: RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days of equity-chart heartbeats to keep (0 = forever). Signals and trades are never deleted.

variables.name: ZMQ_HOST
variables.description: Where the EA's ZeroMQ port is reachable. 172.17.0.1 (the Docker host on the default bridge network) works when pinebridge-mt5 runs on this server; otherwise use that server's LAN IP.

variables.name: ZMQ_PORT
variables.description: ZeroMQ PULL port the EA listens on

variables.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.description: Leave blank to generate one on first start (saved in the Config path as webhook_secret, and the full webhook URL is printed in the log). Or set your own long random string.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Optional: your tunnel's https address (e.g. https://tv-webhook.example.com), so the log prints the exact TradingView webhook URL.

variables.name: REQUIRE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.description: Leave true for anything reachable from the internet. Only set false for local-only testing.
